text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. Everyone has such great 
expressions on their faces."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, have you read it yet? "Number"... 
There are lots of students from Tracen 
Academy featured in it, you know.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The trajectory of dreams... a new radiance 
leading to the future... Just looking at 
it makes my heart race.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. If it stays here, then even in the 
distant future when you read it again, 
you'll still remember me, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No, not just me. Along with many other 
horse girls, and the scenery reflected in 
everyone's eyes... I'm sure of it.
